authorized_openings.scope: One provider-free authored-synthetic current-selection check may run in one task-created unsaved installed-Word document through a disposable ReadDocument-only localhost sideload; no existing document, account, protected data, provider, backend, microphone, write, deployment or release authority.

notes: The exercise is real-host evidence for the existing non-authoritative client-local context frame, not a new GraphQL, REST, Access AI or async contract.
Authenticated Word Online and any public HTTPS development resource remain separately gated.
Provider, patient, clinical, backend, database, microphone, document-write, command, production, deployment and release gates remain closed.

claim_scope: One installed Microsoft Word desktop taskpane read one authored-synthetic exact current selection after an explicit click and local attestation.
The accepted adapter emitted only a typed in-memory current_consult_note frame and the taskpane rendered source, host and counts.
The disposable manifest requested ReadDocument, the server was loopback-only and no existing document or Office account material was inspected.
The unsaved task document, sideload, listener and exact task logs were removed with no task-owned credential, container, network, image or raw-selection residue.

contract_evidence.note: The real-host selection check introduces no appointment context, proposal or command and leaves the Reception One intent contract unchanged.
The client-local selection read neither reads nor alters Diary events, availability, freshness or reconciliation.

decisions.summary: Accept one provider-free authored-synthetic installed-Word current-selection observation while all protected-data, provider, backend and write boundaries remain closed.

title: Clinician One Word Desktop Selection Check
unresolved_gates: Authenticated Word Online behavior, Office identity and clinician-role authorization remain unproven.
Real, product-derived, patient, health, clinical and historical text remain closed.
Any public HTTPS cloud resource and deployment require separate external authority.
Provider, Access AI, backend, database, microphone, document-write, clinical-command, production and release remain closed.
